title: Air Canada Goes Big, Southwest Gets Lounges, and a Cuba Flight Turns Into a Bomb Joke Nobody Should've Made
summary: Air Canada just announced its biggest international expansion ever, and Southwest — the airline that used to brag about not having assigned seats — is building actual airport lounges with Chase. Plus, Zelensky tells airlines to stay out of Russian airspace entirely, Delta has a scary pattern with sick pilots, and one passenger in Miami picks the worst possible joke to make at a gate agent.
